name: Tenebrae
description: Dark, retro macro synth with an edge: snarling basses, drifting pads, screaming leads and long, moving echoes. Eight oscillator models shaped by Shape, Stack and Age, a gritty state-variable filter with two-stage drive, and a cinematic effects chain: chorus, phaser, tempo pump, VHS, tape delay and shimmer reverb. 163 presets plus an Init patch, and a Random page that makes new sounds by category, or varies yours, with a way back.
